summary.headline: Achmet on Decan Figures
summary.text: Pisces weather and agricultural forecast, followed by the beginning of Achmet’s discussion of decan figures. The editor identifies Parisinus 2420 and Marcianus 334 as sources, compares their readings, and traces decan doctrine through Albumasar, Aben-Ezra, Indian astrology, and Teucer the Babylonian as cited by Psellus.
